story_text:
"We’ve been asking for 4K in the rear for a long time—and WOLFBOX has finally done it." — JKU 392 ADVENTURES
“I’m able to line up rocks and different aim points with this tire using the camera. Basically, I’m able to spot myself.” — Truax Off-Road
“I think it’s going to be game-changing for what we’re doing.” — Adventure Further Off Road
## Real-World Prototype Testing
*These videos were filmed with our prototype unit, each in one continuous take with no cuts, so you can see how FlexPilot performs in real-world use. The image quality and colors haven't been fully tuned yet.
We're still working on the details and want to make sure FlexPilot is in its best shape before it reaches your hands. We'll keep you posted as we make progress!
## Meet Us at Global Exhibitions
## Why We Built FlexPilot
## Command the Terrain
## Custom Views. Endless Posibilities.
## Drive every obstacle with confidence
## Full Control of Your Screen Layout
## Clarity in Every Condition
## No More Blocked Rear View
FlexPilot gives you a clear, wide-angle view behind the vehicle — unaffected by passengers, gear, or interior blind spots.
## Fast Transfer. Easy Control.
You just cleared the obstacle. Everyone’s asking, “Did you get that?”
With 5.8GHz Wi-Fi 6, you’re not waiting around for files to transfer.
Open the app. Preview instantly. Download fast.
No removing SD cards. No dragging files to a laptop.
Just pull the clip and share it — while the engine’s still warm.

risks: Bringing a new product to life is never without challenges. From hardware and software development to testing and production, we have faced difficulties along the way—and each one has helped us make the product better. With our experienced team and years of delivering products worldwide, we are confident in overcoming unexpected issues. Our trusted manufacturing and global logistics partners will support fulfillment, while our customer service team will be here to help after delivery. If challenges or delays arise, we promise to communicate openly and keep our backers informed every step of the way.
